images.caption: Federico Faggin, the designer of Intel 4004.When engineer Federico Faggin joined in the early 1970s, Intel was primarily a memory chip company. When he designed the Intel 4004, which became the world's first microprocessor in 1971, it brought new opportunities for the fledgling high tech company., which later led Intel to become the world's largest chipmaker with microprocessors as its core business.

images.filename: Intel light rail shuttle bus approaching Orenco MAX station in 2013 - Hillsboro, Oregon.jpg
images.caption: Intel light rail shuttle bus southbound on Orenco Station Parkway just south of Cherry Drive, approaching Orenco MAX station. This New Flyer D40LF bus was operating on a regular shuttle service, for Intel employees only, which runs every day between the company's huge Ronler Acres campus and TriMet's Orenco/NW 231st MAX (light rail) station, in Hillsboro, Oregon. The service is operated by private charter-bus companies under contract. At the time of the photo, this bus was run by RAZ Transportation, a longtime charter operator in the Portland metropolitan area, while MTR Western was a second charter operator providing some shuttle service to Intel campuses in Hillsboro.  After RAZ went out of business in early 2014, its Intel service (and much of its bus fleet) were acquired by EcoShuttle, another charter-bus company.

images.caption: On May 7, U.S. Consul General Zachary Harkenrider joined Australian Foreign Minister Julie Bishop, Chairman National Disaster Management Authority Maj. Gen Asghar Nawaz, Country Director WFP Lola Castro at the hand-over ceremony of a Humanitarian Response Facility to the Punjab Provincial Disaster Management Authority. The $3 million state-of-the-art facility has been established by the World Food Program with contribution from USAID, Japan, Canada, Australia, the Netherlands, and Denmark. The facility is among 8 being established around the country to augment the emergency and disaster response capacity of the government and the international humanitarian community in Pakistan.
